packages.label: עָפָר וְעַצְבוּת — יְסוֹד הַנְּשִׁיכָה
packages.label_en: Dust and Sadness — The Foundation of the Bite
packages.reason: Both עָפָר (dust) and עַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת (sadness and laziness) are expressions of the same evil, spiritually deadening reality. The teaching states explicitly: 'עָפָר הִיא בְּחִינַת עַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת' — dust IS the aspect of sadness and laziness, because sadness and laziness originate in the foundation of dust (יְסוֹד הֶעָפָר). Dust is the material substrate of spiritual deadness; sadness and laziness are its experiential expression in the soul. Neither produces the other — they are two faces of the same downward, earthbound reality. The entire teaching frames this cluster as the evil force to be avoided: 'one must be very careful' (צָרִיךְ לִזָּהֵר מְאֹד) from these things. Polarity is evil: dust, sadness, and laziness together constitute the domain of the snake — the sitra achra's primary weapon against spiritual life.
